title: From Draft to Delivered - AI Content Pipeline

nodes.label:
Content Need
Identified
nodes.title: Content Need Identified
nodes.info: A segment needs updating, an urgent situation needs an announcement, or the month needs a newsletter paragraph.

nodes.label:
Which Content
Type?
nodes.title: Which Content Type?
nodes.info: Routes to one of three drafting agents based on what is needed.

nodes.label:
AI Managed Mailing List
Drafts Segment Update
nodes.title: AI Managed Mailing List Drafts Segment Update
nodes.info: Proposes moving a contact between segments, such as Waitlist to Active Families.

nodes.label:
AI Generated Announcement
Drafts Message
nodes.title: AI Generated Announcement Drafts Message
nodes.info: Drafts one or more versions of a one-off, situation-specific message.

nodes.label:
AI Drafted Newsletter
Writes Monthly Paragraph
nodes.title: AI Drafted Newsletter Writes Monthly Paragraph
nodes.info: Writes fresh narrative prose highlighting the month's events.

nodes.label:
Human Reviews
Draft
nodes.title: Human Reviews Draft
nodes.info: Every draft, regardless of type, is checked by a person before anything happens with it. This is the node the three branches exist to reach.

nodes.label: Approved?
nodes.title: Approved?
nodes.info: The reviewer can approve as-is, edit and approve, or send it back for a new draft.

nodes.label: Sent or Merged
nodes.title: Sent or Merged
nodes.info: A segment update is applied, an announcement goes out on the channel chosen for it, or the newsletter paragraph is merged into the monthly digest.

nodes.label:
Sent Back for
a New Draft
nodes.title: Sent Back for a New Draft
nodes.info: The agent tries again. Nothing reaches a family from a draft the reviewer declined.
